shortlist.rationale: The firm order, revised to Rs 55 to 67 crore, is at least 37% of FY2026 revenue of Rs 148.65 crore, and the packet shows no earlier firm order of comparable size (the largest firm order before this was Rs 15 crore). It is judged not routine on that basis, with confidence low because the counterparty is unnamed, the value was revised, and the TTM margin and balance sheet are missing. The packet shows no disqualifier and no stressed signal, and the unknowns are the questions for deep research.

result.mechanism: Firm order received 2026-06-23 (counterparty not named in packet, likely the L&T letter of intent of January 2026 converted to an order) with value revised from Rs 45-55 crore to Rs 55-67 crore after a change in scope of deliverables; the company's first firm order of this size in the packet.

result.mechanism: A letter of intent (LOI) from Larsen & Toubro Construction for a water and effluent treatment contract, now revised to a scope change (value INR 55-67 crore). Separately, a 15-20 crore order from Pansen Engineering for WTP, ETP, ZLD and STP work.
result.rationale: Size is stated: the revised L&T contract value of INR 55-67 crore is 37-45% of FY26 revenue of INR 148.65 crore, and the lower bound (37%) is used. The event is not firm: the L&T item is still a Letter of Intent, and the scope change does not convert it to a purchase order, so the engine's FIRM tag is wrong. Watch until the L&T LOI converts to a firm order or contract. The one firm order in the packet, from Pansen Engineering (INR 15-20 crore, 10-13% of revenue), is in the range of orders the company wins regularly (INR 10-15 crore in 2025), so it does not decide the action and is not treated as an inflection.
result.what_changed: On 23 June 2026 the L&T LOI was revised from INR 45-55 crore to INR 55-67 crore after a scope update. The packet's 45 crore FIRM tag is the lower bound of an LOI range, not a firm contract. The Pansen order is firm but routine in size.
contradictions: Packet tags the 45 crore event as FIRM; the 23 June filing amends a Letter of Intent (January 2026) and says only that the terms of the LOI or order remain unchanged, so it is not a firm contract.
Packet tags the Pansen order as unquantified; the 18 June filing gives a price range of INR 15-20 crore, and it is described as received order.
result.next_milestone: Conversion of the L&T Construction LOI (revised to INR 55-67 crore on 23 June 2026) into a firm purchase order or contract, with its value and execution period disclosed.
missing_information: no purchase order or contract from L&T is disclosed; the scope change reason and execution period are not stated
TTM revenue and TTM operating margin not shown (quarterly data absent); FY26 revenue INR 148.65 crore used
market cap about INR 335 crore, roughly 2.3x FY26 revenue, so the cheap-valuation exception does not apply
Pansen execution period 2026-27, price range 15-20 crore; relation to the L&T contract not stated
company-total order book (extracted 125.0 crore at 2026-03-31) not confirmed from a results document
